name: crt-warp
title: CRT Warp
description: A blocky plasma glowing on a curved CRT, with scanlines, a phosphor mask, afterglow, a power-on intro, cursor magnet and click-to-change channel.

files.content:
import type { CrtWarpLook, CrtWarpPreset } from './types';

const CRT_WARP_LOOK: CrtWarpLook = {
  color: '#c755f7',
  backgroundColor: '#120f17',
  lightMode: false,
  mask: 'aperture',
  speed: 0.5,
  variation: 0,
  waveAmplitude: 0.3,
  waveFrequency: 2.5,
  levels: 3,
  columns: 80,
  persistence: 0.4,
  curvature: 0.25,
  corners: 0,
  scanlineStrength: 0.6,
  scanlineFrequency: 200,
  maskStrength: 0.3,
  bloom: 1.5,
  bloomRadius: 1,
  rgbShift: 0.003,
  noise: 0.1,
  flicker: 0.15,
  interference: 0.2,
  vignette: 0.3,
  brightness: 1,
};

const CRT_WARP_PRESETS: Record<CrtWarpPreset, Partial<CrtWarpLook>> = {
  ultraviolet: {},
  amber: {
    color: '#ffb000',
    mask: 'none',
    speed: 0.35,
    waveFrequency: 3.2,
    levels: 4,
    columns: 112,
    persistence: 0.8,
    curvature: 0.35,
    scanlineStrength: 0.75,
    scanlineFrequency: 260,
    bloom: 1.8,
    rgbShift: 0,
    noise: 0.06,
    flicker: 0.1,
    interference: 0.1,
    vignette: 0.45,
  },
  oscilloscope: {
    color: '#3dff7a',
    mask: 'none',
    speed: 0.4,
    waveAmplitude: 0.45,
    levels: 2,
    columns: 64,
    persistence: 0.9,
    curvature: 0.3,
    scanlineStrength: 0.7,
    scanlineFrequency: 220,
    bloom: 2.2,
    bloomRadius: 1.4,
    rgbShift: 0,
    noise: 0.08,
    flicker: 0.1,
    interference: 0.15,
    vignette: 0.4,
  },
  arcade: {
    color: '#e8ecff',
    mask: 'shadow',
    speed: 0.6,
    levels: 5,
    columns: 96,
    persistence: 0.25,
    curvature: 0.5,
    corners: 0.7,
    scanlineStrength: 0.55,
    scanlineFrequency: 240,
    maskStrength: 0.55,
    bloom: 1.3,
    rgbShift: 0.004,
    vignette: 0.5,
  },
  interference: {
    color: '#ff4d6d',
    speed: 0.7,
    waveFrequency: 2,
    columns: 60,
    persistence: 0.5,
    curvature: 0.4,
    scanlineStrength: 0.7,
    scanlineFrequency: 160,
    rgbShift: 0.01,
    noise: 0.24,
    flicker: 0.6,
    interference: 0.9,
    vignette: 0.4,
  },
};

/** Light-background variants of each preset: ink printed on paper. */
const CRT_WARP_LIGHT_SWAP: Record<CrtWarpPreset, Partial<CrtWarpLook>> = {
  ultraviolet: {
    lightMode: true,
    color: '#7c3aed',
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    bloom: 0.6,
    noise: 0.05,
  },
  amber: {
    lightMode: true,
    color: '#b45309',
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    bloom: 0.7,
    noise: 0.04,
  },
  oscilloscope: {
    lightMode: true,
    color: '#15803d',
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    bloom: 0.8,
    noise: 0.05,
  },
  arcade: {
    lightMode: true,
    color: '#3f3f46',
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    bloom: 0.5,
    noise: 0.05,
  },
  interference: {
    lightMode: true,
    color: '#be123c',
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    bloom: 0.6,
    noise: 0.12,
  },
};

/** Full set of visual props for a preset, optionally in its light variant. */
export function crtWarpPreset(
  preset: CrtWarpPreset,
  light = false,
): CrtWarpLook {
  return {
    ...CRT_WARP_LOOK,
    ...CRT_WARP_PRESETS[preset],
    ...(light ? CRT_WARP_LIGHT_SWAP[preset] : {}),
  };
}
